artifact_sha256_binding: The adjacent NUMERICAL_PREREGISTRATION_V1.sha256 is the SHA-256 of these exact JSON bytes.

authority.source_kind: user-attached binding adopted by explicit read-and-act request

shared_case.initial_network: One physical initial particle/network file shared across every grid, timestep, restart, rank, thread, and decomposition case; freeze and hash before the first qualification run.
shared_case.generated_configuration: Freeze and hash before the first qualification run.
settings: central P15 geometry and all other central P15 parameters
P14 export and exact 7.736 reward enabled
splitting, branching, fusion, and topology evolution enabled
all mandatory ledgers and provenance outputs enabled
shared_case.zero_bonded_diffusivity_control: Run at the selected grid/timestep and prove exact zero bonded-D transfer; do not use it to select resolution.

uniform_spatial_levels.AMR_inheritance: No outcome-bearing AMR configuration inherits this qualification; it requires a separate prospective equivalence contract.

outer_timestep_note: O07 may use contract-defined internal transport substeps; these levels are the integrated-model outer timestep.
continuous_scalar_observables: cumulative gross absolute bonded-D transfer counting each virtual pair once
all enabled global A/B/C amount ledgers
cumulative B debit associated with accepted growth
cumulative E debit associated with accepted growth
accepted growth volume partitioned by limiting-resource classification
physical terminal-zone area for each enabled terminal mode
effective terminal uptake area for each enabled terminal mode

vector_observables.mesh_fields: Every enabled Eulerian species field, volume-summed from each run onto fixed G0 analysis cells.

network_x_profiles.segment_partition: Split every segment contribution analytically by centreline intersection with each bin; assigning the complete segment by particle centre is prohibited.

vector_observables.claim_inputs: All P15 profile/front input vectors before fitting or interpretation.

scalar_comparator.scope: Every listed continuous scalar at every observation in both Q-LOW and Q-HIGH.

scales.carbon_and_reward: max(initial total enabled carbon-equivalent inventory,7.736*initial total accounted P)

vector_comparator.scope: Every field and profile vector at every observation in both arms.

weights.concentration_or_density: corresponding cell volume or physical bin width

discrete_topology_comparator.scope: segment, tip, branch, split, fusion, and removal counts at every observation
discrete_topology_comparator.parallel_matrix_override: Parallel stability requires exact topology identity and event order.

nonnegotiable_per_run_gates: no amount below frozen nonnegativity tolerance
global and local P conservation under the frozen P10 comparator
zero global net amount change from bonded transfer within permitted floating accumulation tolerance
complete requested/accepted/rejected uptake and bonded-D ledgers
no missing observation, checkpoint, or provenance artifact
deterministic configuration and initial-state hash verification
continuous/restart equivalence under the frozen restart comparator

spatial.runs: G0, G1, and G2 at T2 for both qualification arms
spatial.G0: select only if G0-to-G1 and G1-to-G2 both pass every gate and limit
spatial.G1: select only if G0 is not selectable and G1-to-G2 passes every gate and limit
spatial.G2: reference-only and not selectable without a finer level
spatial.failure: If G1-to-G2 fails, issue NO_PRODUCTION_GRID and keep C13 blocked.

temporal.runs: T0, T1, and T2 on the selected grid for both qualification arms
temporal.T0: select only if T0-to-T1 and T1-to-T2 both pass every gate and limit
temporal.T1: select only if T0 is not selectable and T1-to-T2 passes every gate and limit
temporal.T2: reference-only and not selectable without a finer timestep
temporal.failure: If T1-to-T2 fails, issue NO_PRODUCTION_TIMESTEP and keep C13 blocked.

coupled_confirmation.comparison: selected (G*,T*) against jointly refined (G*+1,T*+1) for both arms through 216h
coupled_confirmation.gates: Every scalar, vector, topology, conservation, restart, provenance, and hard gate applies again.
coupled_confirmation.failure: No automatic post-outcome fallback or threshold relaxation; freeze and review a prospective v2 before another candidate.

real_requirements.canonical_sort: mesh by cell index; particle data by stable particle key

rank_changing_restart_paths: P0 continuous to 72h then restart as P2 to 216h
P2 continuous to 72h then restart as P0 to 216h
parallel_stability.topology_hash_mismatch: immediate failure even if aggregates agree

long_stability_case.prerequisite: production grid/timestep selected and parallel matrix PASS
long_stability_case.gates: all hard numerical, conservation, provenance, and cap-activation gates

prohibited_actions: run any 216h qualification outcome before independent numerical review
run any P15 scientific outcome matrix before C13 Stage 0 PASS
relax a threshold after observing an outcome
select G2 or T2 without a finer successor
apply this uniform-grid result to AMR
apply the CPU result to GPU execution
claim_boundary: Prospective RG-SW numerical qualification contract only; not mentor approval, calibration, predictive validation, biological-timescale validation, or scientific interpretation.
